title: Ground station offline
description: The ground station we use to talk to the ship has gone offline, so the data can't be sent down.

options.label: Rent a commercial station
options.why: Costs $1M, but the data still gets home on time.

options.label: Store the data on board
options.why: Free, but 30% of the stored data is lost while the memory overflows.

title: Antenna out of line
description: The antenna has drifted away from Earth and the signal is getting weak.

options.label: Point the antenna again
options.why: A repair brings the full signal back and adds 1% to the mission risk.

options.label: Send data more slowly
options.why: The weak signal still works at a lower rate, but 15% of the stored data is lost.

title: Battery cell failing
description: One cell in the battery is getting hot and losing charge.

options.label: Repair the cell
options.why: Costs $2M, but the battery keeps its full capacity.

options.label: Cut the cell out
options.why: Free, but the battery loses 25% of its charge.

title: Solar panels wearing out
description: Space dust and radiation have dimmed the solar panels, so they make less power.

options.label: Turn the panels toward the Sun
options.why: A small thruster burn (2% of the propellant) points the panels back at the Sun.

options.label: Live with less power
options.why: Free, but the battery loses 10% of its charge and 3 science points are lost.

options.label: Switch off extra equipment
options.why: Free, but 5 science points are lost while some equipment stays off.

title: Instrument overheating
description: The science instrument is getting too hot and could be damaged.

options.label: Switch it off for a while
options.why: The instrument cools down safely, but 8 science points are lost.

options.label: Keep it running
options.why: No pause in the work, but the heat costs 20 science points and adds 10% to the mission risk.

title: Data storage almost full
description: The on-board memory is nearly full, and new measurements would be lost.

options.label: Delete the least useful data
options.why: Free, but half of the stored data is erased.

options.label: Send it all down now
options.why: Costs $0.5M for an extra downlink, and no data is lost.

title: Something interesting spotted!
description: The instruments have picked up something unusual that scientists would love to study.

options.label: Point the instruments at it
options.why: Uses 3% of the propellant to turn the ship, but earns 20 science points.

options.label: Stay on plan
options.why: Nothing is spent and nothing is gained.

title: Reaction wheel failing
description: A reaction wheel is wobbling, and the ship is starting to lose its pointing.

options.label: Switch to the backup wheels
options.why: The spare wheels take over at no cost (only if you bought a backup).

options.label: Rebalance the wheels
options.why: Costs $1M, and the wheels spin smoothly again.

options.label: Steer with magnetic coils
options.why: Free, but the pointing is much worse and 15 science points are lost.

title: Star tracker blinded
description: A bright flash has blinded the camera that finds the stars, so the ship doesn't know where it points.

options.label: Wait for it to recover
options.why: Free, but 5 science points are lost while the ship waits.

options.label: Restart the star tracker
options.why: A restart fixes it and adds 2% to the mission risk.

title: Space debris ahead
description: A piece of old space junk is heading toward the ship.

options.label: Dodge with a burn
options.why: Uses 8% of the propellant to steer out of the way (you need a thruster).

options.label: Take the chance
options.why: Costs nothing, but adds 2% to the mission risk.

options.label: Turn the sturdiest side toward it
options.why: Free, but 3 science points are lost while the ship points away, and it adds 1% to the mission risk.

title: Thruster leaking
description: A valve in the thruster line is leaking propellant into space.

options.label: Close the valve
options.why: Stops the leak, but 10% of the propellant is already gone.

options.label: Fix the line
options.why: Costs $0.5M, and the repair stops the leak before any propellant is lost.

title: Solar storm hits the computer
description: Energetic particles from the Sun are flipping bits in the computer's memory.

options.label: Go into safe mode
options.why: The computer waits out the storm, and 5 science points are lost.

options.label: Fix the memory live
options.why: Keeps working, but the repair adds 5% to the mission risk.

title: Software bug
description: A bug in the flight software is making the computer act strangely.

options.label: Restart the computer
options.why: A restart clears the bug and adds 1% to the mission risk.

options.label: Upload a patch
options.why: Costs $0.3M of engineers' time, and it fixes the bug for good.

title: Budget cut
description: The agency has cut the money for the mission and asks you to save.

options.label: Cut some operations
options.why: Saves the money, but 10 science points are lost.

options.label: Find the savings yourself
options.why: Costs $2M of the budget to keep everything running.

title: Extended mission offered
description: The agency would like the mission to keep going after its planned end date.

options.label: Accept the extension
options.why: Earns 15 science points, and costs $2M to keep the team working.

options.label: Decline
options.why: Nothing changes.
